About us

No bullshit.

Our founding value: deeply technical, pragmatic exchanges grounded in real-world practice. Every talk goes through a rigorous review process.

To bring together École Polytechnique alumni and their associates who work in, or are passionate about, artificial intelligence. The result: a community of trust where decision-makers and experts openly share what it really takes to put AI into production.

Status
A group of the AX, the École Polytechnique alumni association, and a non-profit association under the French law of 1901.
Format
8 to 10 evenings a year: 3 to 4 talks from researchers and companies, followed by a buffet reception to talk it over.
Recordings
Every evening is filmed and made available to members and on our public YouTube channel, beyond the Polytechnique circle.
Ground rules
No for-profit activity, no religious or political topics.

How to join us

Current students and alumni of École Polytechnique, working in AI or passionate about it: membership is handled online.

  1. Send your request on the AX website, from the X-IA group page.
  2. The secretary validates your application. You are kept informed of our activities and can register freely for the evenings.
  3. Optional: become a voting member by paying the annual fee (€10 a year, paid on the AX website) to take part in the general assembly and in votes.

The fee is not required to attend the evenings.
